item: The rollup parity over-count fields say over-count: distinct_gap_* become distinct_over_count_*
refs: follow-on to PR #1427 (number set at push)
summary: keyword_daily_parity named two counters distinct_gap_keywords and distinct_gap_total, and they count only the keywords whose rollup distinct count is ABOVE live. The 10-16 benchmark on the user's machine showed distinct_upper_bound_holds false beside both at 0, which reads as a contradiction and is not: the rollup was only ever BELOW live (the flag is distinct_below_keywords == 0), and the gap fields count the other direction. Renamed to distinct_over_count_keywords and distinct_over_count_total, values unchanged; the old names are gone (a benchmark JSON written before this carries the old names). Red without: the new test in test_rollup_parity_bound.py fails on the old names. Not measured: any quiescent re-run of the benchmark on the user's data; that the 10-16 mismatches are the concurrent scrape is inferred (the bounded comparison reproduces the shape on a test corpus).
